title: 2026- MIT Technology Review’s Innovators Under 35
text:
MIRIAM MARTICIC E
very year, our newsroom selects 35 young scientists, entrepreneurs, and inventors who we believe are worth watching in the years to come. They have already made notable progress early in their careers and are emerging leaders in their fields. In this package, we recognize their accomplishments and look ahead to the important work that’s still before them as they confront some of the world’s biggest problems, including human disease and climate change. This year’s class hails from nine countries and was selected from more than 500 nominations with the help of several dozen expert judges. Through ingenuity and persistence, they’re already making their mark. Read more Danijar Hafner Artificial Intelligence This entrepreneur is developing agents that can plan ahead.
